quote: With a total investment of US$26.9 million, the full project is being financed through a combination of sources: a US$11.5 million grant provided through NADBank's Border Environment Infrastructure Fund (BEIF)—funded by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and administered by the Bank—, a US$4.5 million loan, which was used by JMAS to carry out the initial construction, and the remaining US$10.9 million will be covered by local matching funds from Mexican sources.
